title: Rector of BSU named after K. Karasayev took part in the Conference on China-Central Asia Cooperation and held meetings at Xinjiang University

blocks.text: On May 12, 2025, Rector of BSU named after K. Karasayev Mirlan Dyldaev took part in the 2025 China-Central Asia Conference on cooperation in production, education, scientific research and implementation of developments.

As part of the visit, the rector visited the Scientific Research Center of the K. Karasayev BMU at Xinjiang University, where he met with the Vice-Rector of Xinjiang University Jing Gang and the Director of the Center Zhu Xiaojun.

During the negotiations, the prospects for opening a profile on Kyrgyz philology, as well as the possibilities of expanding scientific and educational cooperation, were discussed. Director Zhu Xiaojun informed about the work done by the center, joint publications and upcoming projects.
